نبتغي (form VIII)
# نَبْتَغِي (nabtaḡī) /nab.ta.ɣiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# نَبْتَغِيَ (nabtaḡiya) /nab.ta.ɣi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
